threads.label: The treasure map
threads.text: Finding the treasure it marks is still one of your goals.

threads.label: The Clurichen from the riverbanks
threads.text: You caught Naggeneen the Clurichen in the Golden Egg's basement and handed him to Quinn, who hung him in a bag behind his bar.

threads.label: The black dragon
threads.text: One-armed survivor George told you where its lair is. Eric the Reeve pays a thousand gold for its body. George says nothing pierces its scales and it will soon fly.

threads.label: The missing shipments to Brandonsford
threads.text: No one yet knows what has become of them.

threads.label: Drop Dead Ned's offer
threads.text: For a hundred gold a week, he and his killer wasp will do anything, as long as he gets to kill people. He gives back five gold for each permitted kill.

threads.label: Squints the halfling
threads.text: Trout recruited him as a junior assistant in his Halfling Corps. You and Trout owe him second pick of the first treasure, after the elite members. Until then he pays his own way.

threads.label: Warwick's mithril shirt
threads.text: Dunk spotted the glowing magical chain shirt in the shop of Warwick the smith, and getting it is one of your goals.

threads.label: Ingrid's sleeping potion
threads.text: Dunk gave Ingrid heavily watered-down faun wine from the Faun Grove. Once the potion is made, he must help her dose Warwick tonight, so Dunk can enter the shop while the smith sleeps.

threads.label: Brandon's Barrow Mound
threads.text: Father William marked it on your map. He says its magic sword can kill the black dragon, but George says no one knows if that legend is true.

threads.label: Vivian the witch in the woods
threads.text: Who she is, and whether she shares a coven with Ingrid, is still unknown.

threads.label: Dr. Uriah's promises to Father William
threads.text: He must do penance at the Barrow Mound and donate ten gold for its upkeep.

threads.label: The man-eating giant
threads.text: His huge stone cottage sits on your route north, and he may seize travelers who pass. You rescued Brother Dirk the monk from it and outran him.

closing: You're in the woods north of town, across the field from the giant's stone cottage. Squints and Brother Dirk are with you. You're heading north to the Barrow and pressing Dirk to come along. He still says he should just head home, and Trout has told him he'll report to Squints.
